f75d37d52617fd8123880a69f729d7202949eee8.caption: A mobile phone frame showing a single-item Carousel with a Placeholder Item and a three-dot Scrollmarker. To the right a hand icon with a left-pointing arrow shows a horizontal swipe, and to the left of the phone purple double-headed arrows cross in both horizontal and vertical directions, indicating that horizontal swipe must not interfere with vertical page scrolling.

f85b13c37e82937da99e8581f253023ad8ac2397.caption: Navigation Controls as pairs of round buttons with a left and a right chevron, in the five state columns enabled, hover/pressed, focus, disabled and disabled focus. Row 1 Filled shows dark buttons with white chevrons on a light background, and row 2 Inverse shows white buttons with dark chevrons on a black background; hover/pressed turns the buttons grey, focus adds a ring around them, and disabled shows light grey buttons with grey chevrons.

fd16c9156cd3cfc043e827feffa0d851bf417158.caption: Anatomy of the Multi-Item Variant on desktop in a browser window showing Item 1 to Item 4 side by side inside a dashed purple outline, with Item 5 (hidden) to Item 9 (hidden) continuing to the right outside the window. Callout 1 marks the Container and 2 the Viewport at the top left corner, callout 3 marks the Track, with 3a the visible items and 3b the hidden items. Callouts 4a and 4b mark the Previous control (left, disabled) and the Next control (right, enabled) at the sides, and callout 5 marks the Scrollmarker below.

fd708ef6b7e6611defd62767f93f0b89741e6bbd.caption: Scrollmarker variants in rows: 1 Ghost with dots directly on the background, 2 Filled inside a dark pill, and 3 Inverse inside a white pill. Each row shows a three-page marker with the first page active, and a six-dot marker with the active elongated dot at the first, middle and last position; the active dot is a wide pill and the outer dots shrink when more pages exist. Below, Overflow shows six dots with the first active and the last one smaller, indicating more than five pages.
